original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚信息部长呼吁APC成员摒弃暴力，开展议题导向竞选
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚信息与国家导向部长穆罕默德·伊德里斯在纳萨拉瓦州拉菲亚举行的APC中北部基层动员集会上，呼吁全体APC成员摒弃暴力、打斗及其他形式的政治敌对行为，以和平、议题导向的方式开展2027年大选竞选。伊德里斯还预测总统蒂努布将在中北部地区获得85%的选票。农业国务部长阿利尤·萨比也出席了集会并呼吁支持者坚持和平政治参与。

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚信息部长穆罕默德·伊德里斯呼吁APC成员摒弃暴力与政治敌对行为
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Minister of Information and National Orientation, Mohammed Idris, has urged members of the All Progressives Congress (APC) to shun violence, fighting and other forms of political hostility.

key_facts.fact: 伊德里斯在纳萨拉瓦州拉菲亚举行的APC中北部基层动员集会上发表上述言论
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Idris gave the advice on Saturday while speaking with newsmen at a political rally organised by the APC North Central Grassroots Mobilisation Movement in Lafia, Nasarawa State.

key_facts.fact: 伊德里斯呼吁在2027年大选前开展和平、议题导向的竞选活动
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The minister also urged party members to embrace peaceful and issues-based campaigns ahead of the 2027 general elections.

key_facts.fact: 伊德里斯预测蒂努布将在中北部地区获得85%的选票
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: President Bola Tinubu is going to get 85 per cent of the vote of the North Central.
